The small town of Millbrook opened its new public library on Saturday morning, and more than 300 people came to see it. The old library had been closed for 2 years after a storm damaged the roof. The new building sits next to the river, with large windows, a reading garden and a quiet room for students. Children lined up before 10 to get their first library cards, and a local band played on the front steps. The head librarian, Maria Lopez, said the town had waited a long time for this day. "People kept asking when we would open," she said. "Now they can come every day, even on Sundays."

"בוקר טוב", אמר המוכר כשפתח את הדלת. "כמו תמיד?" "שתי חלות ועוגת שמרים", ענתה מיכל. "ועוד חלה אחת בשביל השכנה החדשה. היא עברה לבניין בשבוע שעבר, ועוד לא יצא לי להגיד לה שלום."
